name: card-spotlight
blurb: Card with a radial spotlight and particle effect following cursor.
description: A card that displays a spotlight effect tracking mouse movement. Uses a canvas layer underneath for particle animations. Radius and color are customizable. High z-index content stays above the effect.
use_when: Hero cards, feature highlights, or attention-grabbing CTAs where the spotlight draws the eye.
avoid_when: Touch-only or performance-sensitive contexts — canvas animation is CPU-demanding.
a11y: Card content is readable text. Spotlight is visual effect only.
